title: Annihilation into two photons
caption: e⁺ + e⁻ → 2γ at rest: charge is conserved (+1 − 1 = 0) and the two rest energies, 2 × 0.511 MeV = 1.022 MeV, become two photons of 511 keV each, emitted back to back. The reverse, γ → e⁺ + e⁻ near a nucleus, needs more than 1.022 MeV.
alt: The equation e plus plus e minus gives gamma plus gamma, with charge and nucleon number conserved and Q equal to 1.022 MeV.
description: Energy released: 2 × 0.511 MeV = 1.022 MeV, shared as 511 keV per photon.
